Traffic advisory
This evening, the Kenya National Highways Authority closed the Nakuru bound carriageway of the Nakuru - Eldoret (A8) Road at Eveready Roundabout following the formation of a sinkhole on the road. KeNHA is working round the clock to ensure normal traffic flow is restored. 
Motorists are advised to exercise caution as they approach the area and follow directions from traffic police and marshals to ensure the safety of all road users.

This evening, the Kenya National Highways Authority (KeNHA) closed the Nakuru-bound lane of the Nakuru–Eldoret (A8) Road at the Eveready Roundabout after a sinkhole appeared on the road. Engineers are already on site working urgently to repair the damage and restore normal traffic flow.

All motorists are advised to slow down when approaching the area and strictly follow instructions from traffic police and marshals to keep everyone safe.
